run_manifest.title: MMB Baseline Reproduction

notes: Always start with devsample before any full-dataset run on VISO.
Use devsample for smoke checks and VISO for reported baseline runs.
Do not change preprocessing, augmentation, or split definitions during reproduction.

run_manifest.objective: Reproduce the current MMB baseline on VISO ship with fixed seeds, locked preprocessing, and a single benchmark protocol before testing any new hypothesis.
